traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Icacinales page, Icacinaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves often alternate (spiral); opposite in many vines.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Icacinales page (read 2026-10-16): as Icacinaceae; fills Oncothecaceae (alternate, our knowledge).

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Icacinales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves exstipulate, often entire, simple.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Icacinales page (read 2026-10-16): trees and lianas.

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Icacinales page, Icacinaceae (read 2026-10-16): evergreen trees; core-asterid node also woody evergreen.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Icacinales page (read 2026-10-16): woody trees and lianas.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Icacinales page (read 2026-10-16): small flowers with valvate free to basally joined petals; regular.

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Icacinales page, Icacinaceae (read 2026-10-16): petals nearly free, valvate, flat (spreading; our reading).

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Icacinales page (read 2026-10-16): none described; Icacinaceae states false.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Icacinales page (read 2026-10-16): no statement; Icacinaceae states superior and Oncotheca ovary superior (our knowledge).

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Icacinales page, Icacinaceae (read 2026-10-16): single-seeded drupe with ribbed or pitted stone; core-asterid node drupe.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Icacinales page, Icacinaceae (read 2026-10-16): mostly bisexual; dioecy common in Phytocreneae and some Iodeae.
